test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which folk dance represents a mock fight between Goddess Durga and Mahishasura?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dandiya Raas.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raas or Dandiya rass** is a** socio-religious folk danc**e, that originated in the **Gujarat region of India.**
 
• It is frequently done during the **Navaratri celebration.**
 
• The dance is done in **Rajasthan's Marwar.**
 
• Sanskrit terms **"Nava" (which means "Nine") and "Ratri" (which means nights) **are used to celebrate the **Hindu deity Shakti,** which means **Strength or Power.**
 
• With the help of Dandiya Raas, the** nine manifestations **of Shakti/Devi are worshipped.
 
• This traditional dance depicts a f**ictitious conflict between Mahishasura and Goddess Durga.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhangra:**

 
 
• Bhangra is a traditional **folk dance of Punjab.**
 
• It takes place during the **harvesting season.**
 
• Bhangra is particularly connected to the** springtime Vaisakhi festival.**
 
 
 
• **Raslila:**
 
 
• The Raslila or Ras dance is a scene from the **popular Krishna tale** found in Hindu scriptures, in which** Krishna dances with Radha and Braj gopis.**
 
 
 
• **Kalbelia:**
 
 
• The Kalbelia are a snake-taming tribe from Rajasthan, India's Thar Desert.
 
• Men play the instruments and give the music, but only women perform it.
